products.create:
CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `product_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_id` int NOT NULL,
  `price` decimal(11,2) NOT NULL,
  `price_vat` decimal(11,2) NOT NULL,
  `before_discount` float(11,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `quantity` double NOT NULL,
  `foc_qty` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `is_bundle` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `bundle_items` text,
  `material` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `unit` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `product_name` text NOT NULL,
  `product_description` text NOT NULL,
  `product_sort` int NOT NULL,
  `product_sort_cc` int NOT NULL,
  `presale_sort` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `bottle_quantity` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `address_other_detail` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `customer_group_title` longtext,
  `companies` longtext,
  `key_value` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `categories` longtext,
  `deleted_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `company_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `erp_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `sku` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `address_meta` longtext,
  `product_meta` longtext,
  `weight` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `volume_2` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `product_images` longtext,
  `volume` longtext,
  `add_on` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `is_coupon` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `show_in_oms` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `for_whatsapp` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `5g` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `pet` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `my5g` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `mypet` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `product_type` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '1 for coupon, 2 for empty 5g bottle, 3 for new 5g bottle, 4 for other',
  `is_custody` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `show_in_load` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `company_price` decimal(11,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `show_in_sales` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `factor` decimal(11,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`),
  KEY `products_status_IDX` (`status`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `products_5g_IDX` (`5g`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `products_pet_IDX` (`pet`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `products_my5g_IDX` (`my5g`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `products_mypet_IDX` (`mypet`) USING BTREE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=20078 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3

  KEY `customers_sub_channel_id_IDX` (`sub_channel_id`) USING BTREE,
  KEY `customers_segment_id_IDX` (`segment_id`) USING BTREE
